hero.title: Rural house in Granada Huerta del Medio
hero.subtitle: Rural house in Granada ideal for families and groups, with pool, garden and natural surroundings just minutes from Granada city.

house.title: The house
house.intro: Vivienda Rural Huerta del Medio is a rural house in Granada with 4 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms and capacity for up to 10 guests. It has a spacious living room with air conditioning and pellet stove, fully equipped kitchen and private outdoor area with pool, barbecue and parking.
house.sectionBody: The house has two floors. On the first floor you will find the living room, equipped kitchen and a full bathroom. On the second floor there are 4 bedrooms: two with double bed and terrace, and two with single beds. There is also a second full bathroom.
